title: Offline Schedule Retention & Real-Time Background Notification
releaseNotes: Offline Timetable Retention: Guaranteed permanent local persistence for class schedules, tasks, and routines with zero-loss protection against empty cloud sync responses.
Autonomous Background Status Bar Ticks: Hooked unremovable timetable status bar card directly into native Android time ticks to transition classes every minute without app interaction.
Background Service Loop Integration: Connected timetable status notification and home screen widgets to native background execution and weather wake-up loop.
Schedule Page Offline Stability: Eliminated timetable loading glitches and premature network sync triggers when launching offline.
